workflows.name: Corporate Disclosure Controls, Materiality Assessment & Selective-Disclosure / Fair-Disclosure Program

Automation Opportunity: - Disclosure-checklist/pre-clearance workflow; material-info register; simultaneous-publish orchestration; spokespeople registry
Controls: - CTL-750: disclosure committee; material-info register; pre-clearance; simultaneous public release; spokespeople trained
Cross-references: - links to VS-100 (legal/RA 8799), VS-22 (compliance), VS-21 (audit assurance), W5011/W5012/W5016 (statements), W5014 (publish), W5019 (ad-hoc), W5022 (insider trading), W5024 (governance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Selective-disclosure risk**: Material info given to one party before public release (RA 8799/Reg FD); mitigated by simultaneous-public-release rule & pre-clearance
- **Materiality-miss risk**: Failing to disclose a material event on time (W5019); mitigated by materiality assessment & escalation
- **Uncontrolled-statement risk**: Spokesperson deviating from approved script; mitigated by pre-clearance & training
System Touchpoints: - Disclosure-committee workflow; material-information register; IR portal/publish (W5014); legal (VS-100); compliance (VS-22); audit trail (VS-88/VS-21)

steps.activity: Operate the disclosure-controls framework: the disclosure committee, the material-information register, the who-can-speak-to-investors policy, the pre-clearance of external statements (earnings W5011, events W5012, ESG W5016), and the evidence/audit trail that every disclosure was reviewed and approved

Run materiality assessment: for any development (operational, financial, legal, ESG, transaction), assess materiality to investors/lenders under SEC/securities standards, decide disclose/withhold, and time the disclosure (links W5019 ad-hoc)

Enforce fair-disclosure (Reg-FD-equivalent / RA 8799): ensure material info is disclosed publicly and simultaneously (no selective disclosure to favored analysts/investors), manage the public-release channel (W5014), and train spokespeople

workflows.name: Annual Report, General Information Sheet & Statutory SEC/Commissioner Investor Disclosure

Automation Opportunity: - Annual-report generation from accounts/ESD; SEC-filing integration; disclosure-checklist; entity-portfolio calendar (VS-166)
Controls: - CTL-750: figures reconciled to audit (VS-17); disclosure-controlled (W5017); filed on time (VS-166); retained (VS-88)
Cross-references: - links to VS-17 (audit/accounts), VS-36 (governance), VS-25 (ESG), VS-72 (intercompany), VS-79/VS-166 (statutory filing), VS-100 (legal), W5009 (narrative), W5014 (publish), W5017 (disclosure), W5023 (related-party)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Filing-deadline risk**: Late GIS/annual report → SEC penalties/loss of good-standing (links VS-166); mitigated by calendar & deadline tracking
- **Misstatement risk**: Annual report figures disagreeing with audited accounts (VS-17); mitigated by reconciliation & audit tie-out
- **Incompleteness risk**: Omitting related-party/ESG/governance disclosures; mitigated by disclosure checklist (W5017)
System Touchpoints: - R2R/external audit (VS-17); legal/disclosure (VS-100/W5017); SEC/electronic filing (VS-166); ESG (VS-25); governance (VS-36); intercompany (VS-72); IR portal (W5014); retention (VS-88)
Time Estimate: - ~4–8 weeks annual-report production; ~statutory filings per entity

steps.activity: Prepare the annual report & investor disclosures: the audited financial statements (links VS-17 external audit), MD&A/group narrative, segment & multi-entity/intercompany disclosure (links VS-72), ESG/sustainability sections (links VS-25), related-party & governance sections (links VS-36/W5023), and the equity-story alignment (W5009)
steps.r: VP IR / Finance / Legal / ESG / Governance

steps.activity: File statutory SEC/commissioner disclosures: the General Information Sheet (GIS), annual report, and entity-level filings for each of the 5 entities (links VS-166 license/permit portfolio, VS-79 BIR), within statutory deadlines
steps.r: Legal / Compliance / VP IR / Company Secretary

steps.activity: Publish & archive: publish to the IR website (W5014) and SEC/electronic system, archive per retention (VS-88), and reconcile every figure to the audited accounts (VS-17) and disclosure controls (W5017)

workflows.name: Material-Event / Ad-Hoc Disclosure, Press-Release Control & Rumor-Response Protocol

Automation Opportunity: - Event-trigger disclosure workflow; rumor-monitoring alerts; simultaneous-publish; crisis-comms playbook
Controls: - CTL-750: material events assessed & disclosed timely; duty-to-correct honored; simultaneous release (W5017); legal-reviewed
Cross-references: - links to VS-14/W1562 (crisis comms), VS-26 (BC), VS-100 (legal/RA 8799), VS-130 (transactions), W5015 (inquiries), W5017 (disclosure), W5014 (publish), W5032 (crisis IR)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Late-disclosure risk**: Material event not disclosed within the required window (RA 8799/SEC); mitigated by event-driven protocol & deadline
- **Duty-to-correct risk**: Failing to correct a confirmed rumor; mitigated by rumor-response protocol
- **Selective-disclosure risk**: Pre-notifying selected parties (W5017); mitigated by simultaneous release
System Touchpoints: - Disclosure-controls (W5017); crisis comms (VS-14/W1562); BC (VS-26); legal (VS-100); IR publish (W5014); monitoring/analytics (VS-28); corporate security (VS-159)

steps.activity: Assess & decide on material events: when a material event occurs (incident, major loss, litigation, leadership change, transaction VS-130, rating action), assess materiality (W5017), decide timing/form of disclosure, and convene the disclosure committee / crisis comms (links VS-14 W1562, VS-26 BC)
steps.r: VP IR / Legal / CFO / Crisis Comms

steps.activity: Issue the ad-hoc disclosure & press release: draft (legal-reviewed, disclosure-controlled W5017), approve, and release simultaneously to public/SEC/IR website (W5014) within the required timeframe — no selective pre-notification

Run the rumor-response protocol: monitor market/media/social rumor (links VS-14 reputation), assess whether a public statement/confirmation/correction is required (duty to correct under RA 8799/SEC), and respond fairly & timely (W5015)

workflows.name: Annual Stockholders' Meeting (ASHM) Investor Notice, Proxy Statement & Information Circular

Automation Opportunity: - Proxy/e-voting platform; notice/circular generation; record-date automation (W5025); outcome-disclosure workflow
Controls: - CTL-750 (ensure controlled execution — Corporate Disclosure, Securities & SEC/Regulatory Compliance (PA-173.2).)
- CTL-750: notice/circular legally compliant; fair-disclosure (W5017); proxy/voting integrity; outcomes disclosed (W5019)
Cross-references: - links to VS-36 (governance), VS-100 (legal), VS-159/W4684 (security), W482 (ASHM logistics in R2R), W5017 (disclosure), W5018 (annual report), W5019 (outcome disclosure), W5025 (register)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Notice/circular-defect risk**: Defective notice/proxy materials invalidating resolutions; mitigated by legal review & statutory compliance
- **Selective-disclosure risk**: ASHM Q&A revealing material non-public info (W5017); mitigated by fair-disclosure & simultaneous publish
- **Quorum/voting-integrity risk**: Proxy/e-voting manipulation; mitigated by controls & audit
System Touchpoints: - Governance/board (VS-36); share register (W5025); disclosure-controls (W5017); e-voting/proxy platform; legal (VS-100); ASHM logistics (W482); security (VS-159/W4684)

steps.activity: Prepare the ASHM investor/proxy materials: the meeting notice, agenda/resolutions, proxy statement/information circular, annual-report linkage (W5018), director/election & audit/compensation disclosures, and related-party/special-business items (W5023) — all disclosure-controlled (W5017) and statutory-compliant

Distribute & manage voting/proxy: notice & circular distribution to shareholders of record (links W5025 register), proxy solicitation/collection, e-voting/quorum, and fair access (links VS-36 governance, VS-159/W4684 security)

Conduct the ASHM & report outcomes: the investor-facing meeting (narrative W5009, Q&A on fair-disclosure W5017), resolution recording, outcome disclosure (W5019), and minutes/governance feed (VS-36) — distinct from the meeting logistics (W482) and security (W4684)

steps.activity: Prepare transaction disclosure: for a debt/equity/securities offering or refinancing (links VS-18 facility, VS-170 ABL/collateral), the offering memorandum/circular/term-sheet narrative, use-of-proceeds, risk factors, and capital-structure impact — disclosure-controlled (W5017) and consistent with accounts (VS-17)

Manage transaction communications & filing: SEC/securities-offering filing (links VS-100, VS-166), investor/lender marketing (roadshow W5012, fair-disclosure W5017), rating-agency briefing (W5013), and simultaneous public disclosure (W5014)

workflows.name: Insider List, Trading-Window & Securities-Trading Compliance (RA 8799 SRC)

Automation Opportunity: - Insider-list/trading-window platform; pre-clearance workflow; trade-reporting automation; anomaly detection
Controls: - CTL-750: insider list maintained; window/pre-clearance enforced; RA 8799 insider-trading ban; trades reported/audited
Cross-references: - links to VS-100 (RA 8799 legal), VS-22 (compliance), VS-36 (board), VS-19 (HR/insiders), VS-21 (audit), VS-119/VS-86 (investigations), W5011 (earnings window), W5017 (disclosure), W5019 (events)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Insider-trading risk**: Insider trading on material non-public info (RA 8799 — civil/criminal liability); mitigated by window, pre-clearance & insider list
- **Closed-period-breach risk**: Trading during blackout; mitigated by hard window controls
- **Reporting-failure risk**: Late/missing insider-trade filing; mitigated by filing calendar
System Touchpoints: - Insider-list/trading platform; HR (VS-19); board/governance (VS-36); disclosure-controls (W5017); legal (VS-100); audit (VS-21); ethics/AML (VS-119/VS-86)

steps.activity: Maintain the insider list & policy: the insiders register (directors/officers/key employees with material non-public info — links VS-36 board, VS-19 HR), the securities-trading policy, blackout/closed periods (pre-earnings), and pre-clearance of trades

Operate the trading window & pre-clearance: open/close the window around earnings (links W5011) and material events (W5019), pre-clear & log every insider trade, and enforce the ban on trading on material non-public info (RA 8799 Securities Regulation Code — insider trading is a criminal offense)

Report & monitor: insider-trade reporting/filing (links VS-100, VS-166), monitor for suspicious/Rule-10b5-equivalent patterns, and audit insider-list/trade logs (VS-21); coordinate investigations (VS-119/VS-86)

workflows.name: Related-Party Transaction, Beneficial-Ownership & Group / Corporate-Structure Disclosure

Automation Opportunity: - RPT register/workflow; beneficial-ownership mapping; group-structure diagram automation; threshold alerting
Controls: - CTL-750 (ensure controlled execution — Corporate Disclosure, Securities & SEC/Regulatory Compliance (PA-173.2).)
- CTL-750: RPT register, arm's-length & audit-committee-approved; beneficial-ownership disclosed; reconciled to accounts (VS-17); audited (VS-21)
Cross-references: - links to VS-100 (legal), VS-22 (compliance), VS-72 (intercompany/group), VS-36 (audit committee), VS-17 (accounts), VS-21 (audit), W5010 (ownership), W5017/W5018/W5019 (disclosure)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Undisclosed-RPT risk**: Material related-party dealings not disclosed (securities-law breach); mitigated by RPT register & approval
- **Hidden-control risk**: Undisclosed beneficial-owner/control changes (RA 8799); mitigated by ownership mapping & threshold disclosure
- **Non-arm's-length risk**: RPTs not at fair value → shareholder harm; mitigated by audit-committee review
System Touchpoints: - Intercompany (VS-72); governance/audit committee (VS-36); accounts (VS-17); disclosure-controls (W5017); legal (VS-100); ownership intelligence (W5010); audit (VS-21)
Time Estimate: - ~continuous; ~annual RPT/ownership disclosure with the annual report (W5018)

steps.activity: Track & disclose related-party transactions: identify RPTs (directors/officers/controlling shareholders/affiliates), ensure arm's-length/fair-value terms, board/audit-committee approval (links VS-36), and disclose per securities/SEC standards (links W5018 annual report)

Maintain & disclose beneficial ownership & group structure: beneficial-owner mapping (links W5010 ownership intelligence), the 5-entity group/corporate-structure (links VS-72 intercompany), control/controlling-shareholder relationships, and threshold-crossing disclosure (links W5019)
Reconcile & assure: reconcile RPTs to the accounts (VS-17 intercompany), assure disclosures (VS-21), and manage any RPT/ownership controversy as a disclosure event (W5019)

Cross-references: - links to VS-36 (governance/board), VS-21 (audit), VS-33 (strategy), VS-100 (legal), W5010/W5013/W5029/W5030/W5032 (intelligence), W5017 (disclosure controls), W5019/W5021 (events)

Review disclosure events & lessons: post-mortem of disclosure events (W5019/W5021), control-effectiveness review, regulatory-change tracking (RA 8799/SEC), and continuous improvement of the IR/disclosure program
